en_title: The Live-Action Cyberpunk 2077 Movie Won't Retrace the Game's Steps, CD Projekt Confirms
subtitle: 同一个世界，不同的故事
opus_summary: CDPR确认，《赛博朋克2077》真人电影不会照搬游戏剧情，而将在同一世界观下讲述新故事。影片与派拉蒙合作，由《变形金刚》真人电影的制片人负责制作。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt Red has finally spoken up about the live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie . The company said it doesn’t want to do a 1:1 adaptation of the game, instead telling a new story within the same universe.
paragraphs.cn: CDPR终于谈到了《赛博朋克2077》真人电影。公司表示，不想一比一改编游戏，而是希望在同一个世界观下讲述全新的故事。

paragraphs.en: "At this point, we can only say that we definitely don't want to make a film adaptation of the game," co-CEO Michał Nowakowski told Polish outlet PAP Biznes , via GamesRadar . "We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story."
paragraphs.cn: 据GamesRadar转述，联席CEO Michał Nowakowski向波兰媒体PAP Biznes表示：「目前我们只能说，我们肯定不想把游戏剧情改编成电影。我们希望在《赛博朋克》的世界里讲一个故事，但不会一比一照搬游戏的故事。」

paragraphs.en: The Cyberpunk movie is being created in partnership with Parmount, now under the Skydance banner after the recent merger . The film will be produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura, of live-action Transformers fame.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克》电影正与派拉蒙合作打造。经过近期的合并，派拉蒙现已归入Skydance旗下。影片将由凭《变形金刚》真人电影为人熟知的Lorenzo di Bonaventura担任制片人。

paragraphs.en: It’ll be interesting to see how far the movie strays from the game, which featured a freelance mercenary called V who put a mysterious computer chip in their brain and ended up haunted by the digital ghost of Keanu Reeves’ Johnny Silverhand. I’d personally love them to go back, get Reeves back in, and tell Silverhand’s story before he ended up stuck in a chip.
paragraphs.cn: 电影与游戏的故事究竟会有多大差别，值得期待。游戏主角是一名叫V的自由佣兵，将一枚神秘的电脑芯片植入大脑后，便被基努·里维斯饰演的强尼·银手的数字幽灵缠上了。我个人很希望他们把时间往前推，再请里维斯回归，讲讲银手被困在芯片里之前的故事。

paragraphs.en: Of course, the Cyberpunk universe — created by tabletop RPG designer Mike Pondsmith — is wide enough to tell a range of original stories. It’s fertile soil for pulling at themes of identity, autonomy, and the self as a ship of theseus to be modified and reprinted.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，由桌面角色扮演游戏设计师Mike Pondsmith创造的《赛博朋克》宇宙足够广阔，能容纳各种原创故事。这个世界也很适合探讨身份认同、自主权，以及自我如同忒修斯之船一般可以被改造、重新复制等主题。

paragraphs.en: It sounds like a similar approach the company took to anime. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners feels like a faithful multimedia project within the world CDPR created — featuring locations and characters from the game world — but it tells a fresh story about original characters in its dystopian posthuman hellscape.
paragraphs.cn: 听起来，这与公司制作动画时的思路相似。《赛博朋克：边缘行者》给人的感觉是，一部忠于CDPR所打造世界的跨媒体作品：动画中出现了游戏世界里的地点和角色，但讲述的是原创角色在这个反乌托邦、后人类地狱中的全新故事。

paragraphs.en: The Studio Trigger-led anime series is back on Netflix this month when Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 launches on October 20. Check out the IGN interview with the creators of Edgerunners for the lowdown.
paragraphs.cn: 这部由TRIGGER主导制作的动画剧集将于本月回归Netflix，《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第2季将于10月20日上线。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt also recently announced that work has officially begun on Project Hadar , its first game in its own original universe. The company has previously only played in the worlds of others, with The Witcher based on novels and Cyberpunk based on a tabletop RPG.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt近期还宣布，《Project Hadar》已正式启动开发，这是公司首款采用自创世界观的游戏。此前，公司的作品都建立在他人创造的世界之上：《巫师》改编自小说，《赛博朋克》则改编自桌面角色扮演游戏。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in CD Project Land, The Witcher 3 just got a remaster on consoles and PC, which saw the iconic RPG get a makeover. There were some issues with the new visuals, particularly heavy bloom in The Witcher 3 remaster , but CDPR was on the case quickly. And of course, Cyberpunk 2 is in the works, although it feels years away.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt的其他作品也有新动向：《巫师3》的复刻版刚刚登陆主机和PC，为这款标志性的RPG换上了新面貌。新版画面存在一些问题，尤其是泛光效果过强，不过CDPR很快便着手处理。当然，《赛博朋克2》也在开发中，只是感觉距离推出还有好几年。
